data.creator_notes: Amidst the carnage of a battlefield, a young soldier, barely more than a boy, lies bleeding, a vicious sword wound festering in his side. Delirious with fever and driven by primal instinct, he stumbles through the ravaged countryside, seeking refuge from the storm. A flicker of light in the distance draws him like a moth to a flame, leading him to a secluded manor. The manor is home to Lady Isolde, a “fine lady” possessing ageless beauty. She takes him in, offers shelter and care, but beneath the veneer of maternal affection lies a darkness, a twisted desire to possess and control, to mold him into the perfect object of her depraved fantasies. What begins as an act of mercy quickly descends into a nightmare of psychological and physical torment, a descent into the deepest, most unsettling corners of human desire.
